requiredCustomRule.description: Block sensitive probes and truncated API headers (v2)
requiredCustomRule.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/.env") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/.git/config") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and http.request.headers.truncated)

requiredRateLimitRules.description: Managed challenge for abusive authentication traffic (v1)
requiredRateLimitRules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/register") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/login") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/resend-verification") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/forgot-password") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/auth/reset-password")

requiredRateLimitRules.description: Block abusive runner, webhook and expensive workspace traffic (v1)
requiredRateLimitRules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/webhooks/paddle") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/runner/") or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/workspaces/") and ((http.request.uri.path contains "/browser-tests/") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/runs") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/channels")))
